name: inspect_go_binary
description: Inspect embedded Go compiler version, main module, dependency/replacement versions, build settings and optional inferred static (ptr, len) UTF-8 string literals in an explicit local ELF, PE or thin Mach-O image, or the slice of a universal Mach-O named by architecture (read without lipo; artifact stays the universal file, selected_slice records the slice and source ranges stay file offsets). Default detail complete returns original artifact SHA-256, exact build-info source ranges, raw framed module bytes and unparsed module-text lines inline as observed Evidence; include_string_literals: true adds bounded deduplicated string_literals (default max_string_literals 2,000, max 10,000, <=4,096 bytes each, <=512 KiB aggregate, 64 MiB header-scan budget) recovered from word-aligned (ptr, len) headers in non-executable mapped data pointing within single read-only spans. Explicit detail summary retains the same complete parent and returns compiler/main-module identity, counts, source ranges and parent_evidence_id. Query retained rows through inspect_analysis_view kind go, collection dependencies, settings or string_literals (exact values or substring contains when collected); select indices, fields and pagination. Rows always retain their original index scoped to the parent Evidence; empty filters select none. Runtime dependency completeness and string reachability remain unknown. Supports inline and historical pointer encodings without installing Go, opening a disassembler, executing the target, writing temporary files or accessing the network. Missing metadata is reported as unknown, not proof that an image is not Go. Does not recover functions, source mappings, types or runtime behavior. Resource guards bound files to 256 MiB and charge each distinct build-info search span in full against a cumulative 256 MiB header-search budget, with partial overlaps charged separately; they also bound aggregate embedded build-info strings to 1 MiB, structural table decoding to 16 MiB and complete inline metadata to 8 MiB; malformed, unsupported and oversized inputs receive typed failures rather than partial success.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

architecture.description: CPU family of the slice to read from a universal (FAT) Mach-O. Required for universal files and rejected for every other image.

detail.description: complete returns all metadata inline; summary retains complete Evidence and returns build identity and counts for subsequent retained Go views.

include_string_literals.description: Also recover bounded inferred Go UTF-8 string literals referenced by static (ptr, len) headers in non-executable mapped data

max_string_literals.description: Maximum distinct recovered string literals (1-10000; default 2000; requires include_string_literals: true)

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the selected executable or library
